posts.author_bio: Redefining beauty in Carbondale. Ella Rose is your go-to for elevated, intentional, luxury salon experiences.
posts.post_caption:
✨ Summer is calling… and so are fresh nails. ☀️💅💖

Whether you’re drawn to soft pastels or vibrant pinks, a signature gel manicure is the perfect finishing touch for every summer adventure. Clean cuticles, flawless shaping, and a glossy finish that keeps your nails looking beautiful long after you leave the salon.

Some days call for subtle elegance. Other days deserve a bold pop of fun. The best part? You don’t have to choose,summer is the perfect season to wear both!
